derivation: Mechanically derived: parent decisions carried across, renamed headers resolved via the perturbation log. No new judgement.

rationales.Style No: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Style number is the manufacturer's identifier for the product model; it repeats across colour and size rows, while gtin carries the variant level code.
rationales.STYLE NAME: Renamed from 'Style Name' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Marketing name of the style; the CDM has no product name field.
rationales.Season: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Merchandising season (SS27); not passport data.
rationales.Gender: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Target consumer segment; the CDM has no field for it.
rationales.FABRIC CONTENT: Renamed from 'Fabric Content' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Fibre content with percentages (60% organic cotton, 40% recycled polyester).
rationales.Fabric Wt (gsm): Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Fabric areal density in g/m2; netWeight is the weight of the finished product, so it does not match.
rationales.Colour: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Colour of the garment variant.
rationales.Size: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Size of the garment variant.
rationales.Country of Origin: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Country where the product was made.
rationales.Factory: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Legal name of the company that makes the garment.
rationales.FACTORY ID: Renamed from 'Factory ID' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Identifier code of the production facility (LKA-0412).
rationales.HTS Code: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Customs tariff classification for the product.
rationales.Care Ins: Renamed from 'Care Instructions' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Washing and drying instructions.
rationales.UPC/EAN: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. 13 digit values with EAN-13 structure, one per variant, which is a GTIN-13.
rationales.Carton Qty: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Packing quantity per carton; logistics data.
rationales.FOB Price (USD): Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Commercial price; outside the passport scope.
rationales.Lead Time (days): Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Production lead time; commercial planning data.
rationales.PO No: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Purchase order number.
rationales.Rev: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Revision number of the tech pack document, not the product.
rationales.APPROVED BY: Renamed from 'Approved By' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Internal approver name for the tech pack; no matching CDM field.
rationales.Comments: Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Free text QC and approval notes (wash test, shade band); not a structured conformity declaration.
rationales.Recycled Fibre (%): Unchanged from parent heldout_h3_techpack. Share of recycled fibre in the product (40%), consistent with the 40% recycled polyester in Fabric Content.
